map.一次性缴清的纯保费: Pure premium paid in one lump sum
map.在给定死亡率与利率下，死亡给付的现值即净趸缴保费。: Under given mortality and interest, the present value of death benefits is the net single premium.
map.📖 查看「一次性缴清的纯保费 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pure Premium Paid in One Lump Sum User Guide"
map.NSP 为未来死亡给付按利率贴现的期望值。: NSP is the expected value of future death benefits discounted at the interest rate.
map.简化假设各年死亡率相同。: A simplifying assumption is equal mortality each year.
map.📚 深度解析：净单保费（一次性缴清纯保费）: 📚 Deep Dive: Net Single Premium (Lump-Sum Pure Premium)
map.把未来各年给付按预定利率折现求和，得趸缴净保费。: Discount future yearly benefits at the assumed interest rate and sum them to get the net single premium.
map.对比不同预定利率下的净单保费。: Compare net single premiums under different assumed interest rates.
map.NSP = Σ 100万/(1.03)^t (t=1..10) = 100万×ä: NSP = Σ 1M/(1.03)^t (t=1..10) = 1M×ä₁₀@3% (≈8.530) ≈ 8.53M. That is, the net single premium is about 8.53M.
map.净单保费含费用吗？: Does the net single premium include expenses?
map.不含。它是纯风险现值，毛保费还要乘 (1+附加费率) 并考虑缴费方式。: No. It is the pure risk present value; the gross premium also multiplies by (1+loading rate) and considers the payment mode.
map.净单保费和趸缴保费差多少？: How much does the net single premium differ from the single premium?
map.净单保费等于纯风险现值，趸缴保费等于净单加费用附加（一次性）。健康体趸缴通常比分: The net single premium equals the pure-risk present value; the single premium equals net single plus expense loading (one-time). Healthy-life single premium is usually 15-30% above the installment net-single present value; the gap is expense and profit margin.
